queries.description: One clear question per distinct need. Preserve names, identifiers, and filenames verbatim.

query.description: One-question compatibility form; do not supply with `queries`.

targets.description: Sources to search. Omit `targets` or use an empty Sources object to default to 15 results.

date.description: Relative source-date window; not with `from`/`to`; not historical.

from.description: Inclusive start, UTC YYYY-MM-DD; not with `date`.

limit.description: Omission returns 15 results. Maximum 20 for this target; limits across all selected targets must total at most 20.

source_systems.description: Open-ended source-system identifiers such as google_drive, slack, linear, or figments.

to.description: Inclusive end, UTC YYYY-MM-DD; not with `date`.

within.description: Opaque read references from earlier Source results. Search stays within those exact current record revisions.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation returned by this same target. When set, omit the target's other controls.
